findings.description: Never-blank invariant, test-pinned as a regression guard. In the real code, the five reserve-summary figures (Accrued/Moved/Paid/Outstanding/Shortfall) are built via `fmt_cents(...)` directly (lib.rs render_tax, lines 730-734), which always emits a formatted string (e.g. `"0.00"` for zero) — there is no `Option`/degrade path here, unlike the Positions tab's `Est. Tax Rate` column which explicitly does `.map(fmt_ppm).unwrap_or_default()` and CAN render empty. tests/formula.rs's `reserve_summary_carries_all_five_kernel_exact_columns` explicitly asserts `!row[rcol(name)].text().is_empty()` for all five columns, with the in-code comment '(the gap the review flagged)' — i.e. this was a previously-identified defect class now pinned by a regression test. SHEET-TAB-005's text ('consumed as pure values') says nothing about blank-vs-zero handling or that these five columns can never degrade to empty. All three B-runs (B1 unwanted-behavior clause, B2 item 8, B3 unwanted-behavior clause) independently surface this exact invariant.

Strict 1:1, input-order pass-through of `annual_rows` — never sorted, grouped, or filtered. `render_tax`'s reserve-row loop (lines 725-736) is a plain `for r in annual_rows` push with no `.sort_by(...)` anywhere, and `reserve_summary_carries_all_five_kernel_exact_columns` zips `tax.reserve_summary.rows` against `annual.iter()` positionally (line 359) plus asserts `tax.reserve_summary.rows.len() == annual.len()` (line 357) — pinning row count and row *order* to input order. SHEET-TAB-005 says only 'per (Jurisdiction, Tax Year)', stating the key but nothing about ordering, filtering, or aggregation. Notably, all three A-direction sketches independently invented the *opposite* rule — sorting output by `(Jurisdiction, Tax Year)` ascending 'for deterministic sheet layout' — each explicitly flagging it as an assumption with no spec basis (A1 assumption #4, A2 assumption #3, A3 assumption #5). Per the classification rule this doesn't count as an A-side finding (self-disclaimed, no spec-text basis) but it is a striking near-miss: the spec's silence on ordering led every fresh A-implementer to guess a rule the real code contradicts.

Cell-typing rule: every reserve-summary cell (and every accrual-band cell) is `Cell::Value`, never `Cell::Formula`. Structurally there is no code path in the reserve-row loop that could construct a `Cell::Formula`, and `tax_tab_is_kernel_exact_not_live_formula` explicitly asserts `!cell.is_formula()` over every cell in both `tax.accruals` and `tax.reserve_summary`. This is pinned as a deliberate contrast with the Positions tab's `GOOGLEFINANCE`-driven formula columns (`price_formula`, `quote_date_formula`, etc.). SHEET-TAB-005's 'consumed as pure values' gives partial textual cover for this, so it's the weakest of the three tighter findings, but the code/tests go further than the text by asserting it symmetrically across BOTH Tax bands and by name-checking it against the Positions live-formula concept the EARS text never mentions.

Exact formatting/normalization rules are pinned by code, not by spec text. `fmt_cents` (lines 473-478) fixes the rule: sign character only if negative, then `abs/100`, `.`, zero-padded two-digit `abs%100` (e.g. `Cents(5000)` -> `"50.00"`). `jurisdiction_label` (lines 752-757) fixes `Federal` -> literal `"Federal"`, `State(code)` -> `"State({code})"` with the code interpolated verbatim. Tax Year renders as `r.tax_year.0.to_string()` (line 729) — a bare, unpadded decimal. `reserve_summary_carries_all_five_kernel_exact_columns` independently reimplements the same cents formatter to check equality, and separately asserts the exact string `"Federal"` and `"2022"` for the staged row. SHEET-TAB-005 states none of this — no currency format, no jurisdiction string convention, no year format — leaving it entirely to the implementation.

Structural separation: `TaxView { accruals: ViewTab, reserve_summary: ViewTab }` (lines 156-165) with the reserve summary published as its own tab (`TAX_RESERVE_TAB` = `"Tax · Reserve Summary"`, its own `TAX_RESERVE_HEADER`), never interleaved as blank/label/embedded-header rows inside the accrual band's one-row-per-accrual range. This is the weakest finding of the five: the SHEET-TAB-005 text already names the band ('populate the `Tax · Reserve Summary` band'), so the band's existence and name are spec-anchored — only the 'kept as a wholly separate range, never embedded in the accrual band' framing is pure code/doc-comment surplus, and it plausibly belongs to a sibling EARS ID (about the Tax tab's overall band layout) rather than SHEET-TAB-005 specifically.

notes: Direction A produced no genuine spec-side-surplus findings. All three A-runs converge on the same core, correctly-scoped structure (a pure field-for-field passthrough of accrued/moved/paid/outstanding/shortfall as Cents, no recomputation, no dedup/aggregation), and every place they go beyond that — output sort order (Jurisdiction,TaxYear) ascending, one row per input entry with no zero-fill, a fallible Result-returning publish path in A3 only — is self-flagged by the runs themselves as an invented assumption with no basis in the EARS text ('not specified explicitly, this is my interpretation' / 'ordering ambiguity ... an assumption beyond the spec text'). Per the classification rubric that makes these assumption artifacts, not findings, even where (as with sort order) they happen to contradict the real code's actual behavior (real code preserves annual_rows' input order untouched, per the zip-based test). A3's modeled fallibility is the one point of A-internal disagreement (A1/A2 model an infallible pure function; A3 wraps it in a Result-returning publish call) but it doesn't rise to inconsistency — the shared core (pure Cents passthrough, no tax math, no derivation of outstanding/shortfall from the other three figures) is identical across all three, and none of it traces to text the real code contradicts. Direction B, by contrast, is highly consistent across B1/B2/B3 and each independently names close to the same five pinned-but-unstated behaviors (blank-handling, order/count, cell typing, formatting/normalization, band separation), grounded in the same tests/formula.rs assertions and lib.rs functions. Net: only Direction B surfaces material, code+test-pinned surplus the given EARS text is silent on; Direction A's disagreement with reality (sort order) is a real observation worth carrying forward operationally, but it fails the finding bar as written since the spec text simply never forces or suggests an ordering rule at all.
